messages:
From: Samantha Price <sprice@google.com>

Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: GCP listing checklist & co-sell alignment — NovaHealth

Hi Markus / Vanessa / Laura,

Quick intro — I'm Samantha, Partner Manager on the GCP Marketplace team. NovaHealth is nearing procurement approval and wants to list Redwood Inference in the GCP Marketplace and discuss a coordinated co-sell plan. I attached our standard checklist to help triage readiness and speed the intake.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm listing owner and point of contact at Redwood.
- ETA on required artifacts (SaaS endpoints, public pricing, legal contact).
- Any data residency or VPC requirements NovaHealth flagged during procurement (cc'd).

Can we do a 30-minute sync this week to map a mutual action plan and identify any blockers? Proposed times: Thu 3/11 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 3/12 11:00–11:30 PT.

Attachment: GCP_co-sell_checklist_v2.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Samantha Price
Partner Manager, Google Cloud Marketplace
sprice@google.com
GCP Marketplace Team
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: GCP listing checklist & co-sell alignment — NovaHealth

Thanks for the intro, Samantha — and thanks for the checklist. Markus here (Partner & Marketplace Lead at Redwood Inference). We're excited to move NovaHealth toward listing.

Short answers up front:
- Listing owner: Markus Klein (me) — technical lead is Karthik Iyer (cc).
- ETA for artifacts: public pricing + short product blurb by 3/18; legal contact and MSA redline window by 3/24.
- No special VPC requirements flagged yet from NovaHealth; will confirm with procurement (cc'd).

Proposed agenda for the sync (30m):
1) Confirm intake checklist items and owners
2) Timing for public pricing + listing metadata
3) Co-sell motion: GCP lead handoff, joint assets, and sales play
4) Risks/blockers and immediate mitigations

Either Thu 3/11 10:00 PT or Fri 3/12 11:00 PT works for us. If you prefer, I can send a Doodle, or we can lock Thu.
